notes.title: EA Version 4.0 Update
notes.content:
Hellow my fellow gamers! Afte months of repolishing the game, it's finally ready for EA4.0. 
The story is now complete, thank you for the wait and the support! 

[h3]Important Updates：[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the final new part of the story, 2 levels, the final boss and ED. 
[*] Performance optimizations, especially for low graphics settings
[*] Reduced the number of unnecessary combat special effects, enhanced the performance of each level. 
[*] Enhanced the movement cancelling mechanism. Now you can cancel the after-movement lag with dodging, rolling or switching weapons. 
[*] Reduced the total HP of some bosses in higher difficulties. 
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the jumping level - Lotus Pool. 
[*] Reduced the duration of the frame freeze. 
[/list]

[h3]Added：[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fast backpack：Press Select/L3/Rs/I to call out fast backpack
[*] Increased the max level of the sword to LV5, added two new combos. 
[*] Dark Energy skills are now controlled by direction buttons/keys
[*] A tutorial will pop up when switching weapons for the first time to avoid accidental commands. 
[*] Added a new move to the scyth at LV2.
[*] Skins will now show status properly when equipped
[*] Added some Azure shop for convenience. 
[*] Collectable weapon skins will be sold in Azure Shops in the latter process of the game
[/list]


[h3]Fixed several hundred bugs: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Bugs regarding resolution settings 
[*] Abnormal bumping in some maps
[*] Unlock the secret after completing the game
[*] Fruits in The Forest is now available
[*] Massive bugs that would get you stuck
[*] No damage done by Chimera's Fire
[*] No items are put in the bag when purchased in the Azure Shop in Level 3
[*] Fixed some item usage error
[*] Fixed some uncontrolable sound effects
[*] Fiexed some CG will call out the menu
[*] Fixed some compass errors
[/list]

[h3]OST DLC Update：[/h3]
Added 10 more pieces
[list]
[*] 神跡戦争
[*] 浄化の泉
[*] 遺跡秘境
[*] せいれいウォーズ(BOSSミッシェルとバトル)
[*] 決戦の前
[*] 最後のBOSSと団長サイナーのバトル
[*] 終わりの終わり
[*] MYSTERIA～魂の行方～
[/list]

[h3]Q&A：[/h3]

Q：There are frame drops when slaying the monsters
A：It's not frame drop but frame freeze, please turn it off if in the menu you feel uncomfortable. 

Q：The autosave fuction makes the game stutter
A：All save slots are saved at the same time, we recommend to have less than 10 saves. 

Q：Why the frame rate in the ring like map is especially lower than others?
A：The system will load maps when in that map, the frame rate now depends on the I/O speed of your drive. If you stand still the frame rate will get higher

Q：How to get higher frame rate? 
A：First lower the shadow setting, then tweak the other settings. 

Q：How to backup/delete the whole savedata?
A：The whole savedata is a .mss file under C:\Users\{Your User Name}\AppData\Local\Mysteria\Saved 

Q：Why the edges is smudgy when displayed on high DPI screens? I
A：Please select change the DPI settings in compatibility under property of the .exe file of the game. 

Q：Occational crashes/freezes
A：Unfortunately due to the overly complicated base structure, this happens. We recommend you to enable virtual memory at around 32GB (32768MB). 
If the game crashed and took the savedata with it, please contact me: uhome@u-secret.net , I'll send you a complete savedata and a wallpaper. 

-Producer Final.Unreality(Cat）

notes.title: EA2.50 Version Update Note
notes.content:
Thanks to all your suppoort during this dark time, we're back unharmed and more ready to face the challenge than ever! 

But still, we apologize for the lack of updates for the past a month or so due to the outbreak of the COVID-19. Here's wallpaper that I drew the other day for all of you, just to say we're sorry! I hope this and the coming update can bring you some joy during the time of staying home.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380636/aa3df35a62098823ec84ac91081f9fff73186c3c.jpg[/img]
Here's the link to download the wallpapers: https://www.dropbox.com/s/psfkqu8rgfjpjre/EA_2.50_WALLPAPERS.zip


[b]Important Updates: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added about 1.5 hours of new story. 
[*] 	Added two featured levels. 
[*] 	More optimization, to let the engine utilize the GPU better and reduce usage. 
[*] 	Optimized the redering effects in the featured levels. 
[*] 	In this version, you can re-enter the forest to play some more even if you've reached the end of the game. 
[*] 	Changed the heavy attack of the Sword, added 2 skills and unlocked the max level of the sword of Lv5. 
[*] 	Added "New Game+", you'll restart the game with your current weapon level if selected. 
[*] 	Added "Select Chapter+", you'll restart the chapter selecter with you current weapon level. 
[*] 	Added "Change Difficult", you go back to the main title screen to change the difficulty when you are not at the highest level. 
[*] 	Added taunt notification for the Fox Siblings.  
[*] 	The portrait mode is set on on default during cut scenes, you can turn it off in the settings. 
[/list]

[b]Added:[/b]
	[list]
[*] New item "Cat Cake', it restores dark energy. 
[*] 	New Weapon Skins
[*] 	Limited Character Skin for the highest level, defeat the Fox Siblings to get it. 
[/list]

[b]Fixes: [/b]
	[list]
[*] Got the missing tales back (that shows up after entering a new world) 
[*] 	Fixed several bugs that may damage the savedata after force quit (though we still advise AGAINST doing so)
[*] 	Fixed the bug that caused the camera to rotate like crazy during an execution. 
[*] 	Fixed the bug that caused the animation to disappear when switching in Dark Mode. 
[*] 	Fixed the bug that caused the character abnormally comes back to life. 
[*] 	Added autosave notification, please don't turn off power during. 
[/list]

Again, thanks for all the support! We'll keep going! Stronger than ever! 

Cat

notes.title: EA2.10 Version Update Note
notes.content:
Hey guys, I'm here to bring you guys the EA2.10 Vesion Update. This update is more of a transitioning one focusing on optimization and system integration rather than adding more content. 
The 2.5 version will have more content but we have no choice but to push it back due to recent flu attack and some of our staff are hospitalized. They are fine now btw. We're throwing everything we have to 
Again a huge thanks for all of your support! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380636/45c33e85b98c2efc38210dc0c6c1e35c10930a5a.jpg[/img]
[b]Important Updates: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Guard System. Pressing Ctrl/LB/L1 to guard against normal attack. 
[*] Added a reflect system: You can return the throwables back to the enemies by striking it. 
[*] New Options: Portrait Stacking/Portrait&Background Blurring. 
[*] Added a Outfit Sync System: The outfit between old and new savedata will be synchronized.

notes.title: EA 1.50 Ver Update Note
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Cat here! I'm sorry I haven't been very responsive for the last couple of weeks, I've devoted all I have to this game and still am. 
Anyway, there's some result we've achieved in the recent weeks. Please enjoy! 

[b]Major updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Better performance, increased loading speed and frame per second in every scene. 
[*] 	Unlocked 2 more chapters, which is 1.5 times longer than the original EA version. 
[*] 	Optimized input lag. 
[/list]


[b]Fixes and Optimizations: [/b]
[list]
[*] 	Optimized the effect of strike. 
[*]  	Optimized UI resolution's auto detection. 
[*] 	Optimized the facial expression of most characters. 
[*] 	Optimized the outer lining of the characters. 
[*]  	Remade the tutorial, the instruction of the more complicated moves will spread on multiple pages with videos attached. 
[*] 	Fixed the text that comes out of the text boxes. 
[*] 	You can now go back to get the outfit shards. 
[*] 	Optimized the strike feedback. 
[*] 	Fixed the AOE attack bug. 
[*] 	Optimized the shadow texture in the first boss fight. 
[*] 	Fixed the attack perimeter settings. 
[*] 	Optimized the AI of the mosters. 
[*] 	Minor bug fixes. 
[*] 	Fixed the bugs that caused players unable to unlock certain achievements. 
[/list]

[b]Added：[/b]
[list]
[*] 	More skill due to that the character will unlock "Shadow Mode" after Chapter 4, which is the overdrive mode and will provide more skills. 
[*] 	Japanese subtitles and UI are now supported. 
[*] 	More camera settings. 
[*] 	A function to delete one single savedata. 
[/list]


[b]Fixed：[/b]
[list]
[*] 	UI and input system
[*] 	Controller settings can now detect which type of controller you are using and set the buttons automatically. 
[*] 	The Camera stutter issue. 
[*] 	The weapon will be switched back to what you were using before the excution. 
[*] 	Brand new physics effects on characters. 
[/list]

[b]For those who played the game before this update: [/b]
[list]
[*] The button setting is completely reset. 
[*] You can still change the settings according to your favor. 
[/list]

[b]Q&A：[/b]
Q：How to avoid stutter- 
A：If your system specs just met the "Recommended" one, please use High instead Ultra. 
Visually speaking, high and ultra have very little difference. 

Q：How to delete the savedata completely？
A：The main savedata is a .mss file, please find it under C:\Users\{YOUR USER NAME}\AppData\Local\Mystria\Saved and delete it. 

Q：How to fix the mushy parts around the edge of the screen in high DPI screen (2K, 4K display)?
A：Right click on the .exe file of the game, click on "Compatibility" and change the DPI settings to "Override high DPI scaling behavior" and restart the game. 

Q：I played the PTU version of this game, the savedata is corrupt, what should I do? 
A：Thanks for helping us optimizing the game, we recommend you to delete the savedata before playing the new version. 

Thank all of your soooooo much for helping us! Please stay tuned for more exciting contents in the future! 
Developer - Final.Unreality(Cat）

notes.title: About Test Branch and Future Updates
notes.content:
Hey guy, 

It’s me again. I’d like to thank you for all the love, support, encouragement, criticism and feedback. I and the team now have a better understanding on how to proceed in the future. 

Thank you! 

Based on what we’ve gathered, we’d like to [b]initiate a deeper public test[/b], to let you know what we’re changing and adding and how we’re doing it. 

After some discussion, we’ve come to a conclusion that the best way for you to participate is to start a test branch, a BETA version of the game on Steam. 

[h1]Before you participate, please hear out what we have to say about it: [/h1]
1. There might be unfinished UI. 
2. There might be unfinished text or text that has not been localized or poorly localized. 
3. Unfinished levels. 
4. Unfinished checkpoints that will potentially corrupt save data. 
5. Unexpected crashes. 
6. The game may unexpectedly increase CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM usage, or result in severe frame rate drop. 

[h1]In the meantime, [/h1]
1. You’ll be able to see our future updates before the formal patches. 
2. Possible update direction. 
3. New systems and/or gameplay in its early stages. 
4. Old levels and maps that are drastically optimized. 

[h1]In a nutshell: [/h1]
Participating in this Public Test will grant you the access to our latest results, but there’s no guarantee if we were to change or discard some or all of them, that means no matter the features are finished or not, we’ll pack it up and upload it to the test branch, unless there’s technical difficulties that prevent us from packing. 

We hope this could make your participation in the development of this game more direct and more objective, also to show those who backed on Kickstarter that we’re going to take the development extremely seriously. 

We’re update the test branch [b]WEEKLY[/b], and only update features or optimizations that most are content with to the official build. 

[h1]How to activate BETA: [/h1]
Steam Library->Right click on Mysteria~Occult Shadows~->Select Property->Select BETA->input code “InPublicTest”->click on “CHECK CODE”->Select “publictest”. 

If you wish to quit BETA, just select “None” instead of “publictest”. 

[h1]About feedback and suggestions: [/h1]
1. There's a thread in Discussion, you can leave a comment there. 
2. Please contact us directly, our email is uhome@u-secret.net. 

Thanks again for all the love. 

FinalUnrealityCat
U-Secret Studio

notes.content:
Patch Note 2019.08.25

Thank you all of the criticism, love and support! We've gathered a ton of useful information and will start the fixing the the next few patches. 

Due to the restructuring of the save data, we recommend you to delete your current save data and create a new one. 
To delete the save data, please delete the .mss file under C:\Users\YOUR USER NAME\AppData\Local\Mystria\Saved. 

1. Optimized control input delay. 
2. Significantly reduced VRAM and RAM usage. 
3. Fixed the severe frame drop in the Dimentional Passage. 
4. Fixed the severe frame drop during the OP video. 
5. Optimized the tutorial, players should be able to learn about the controls and mechanism more easily. 
6. Optimized the UI of Graphics Settings. 
7. Optimized the display when picking up items. 
8. Fixed the bug that caused the auto-reset to Chinese when last chose English. 
9. Fixed the bug that caused display error after using the skill of Scythe: "Soul of Death". 
10. Fixed the bug that cause random achievements to unlock. 

------------------------
------------------------

*We'll keep up the good work! （2019.08.23）


I'd like to thank your personally for the love and support from you guys. This is the first time we make an ACT game, also the first time we release the game on Steam. 

After the innitial release today we've received over 200 reviews, I'd like to thank all of you for the feedback, criticism or plain support. Due to lack or skill and resources, the EA 1.0 version is plagued with bugs and glitches. I'm sorry for the experience and the trouble. 

We're gathering all advice and suggestions from every resource we can, and will put all that on our to-do list. We'll do our absolute best to optimize, fix and add new content to the game. 

I've acknowledge my childishness and inadequacy during this release. But I'm will never give in. This project is like my child, I'll keep working on it until everyone is content with it. 

We're a team made up by college students. We love games and anime culture. This game is the fruit of 3 years of countless all-nighters, argue and hard work from all of us. We'd like to thank you for your support, and please have faith in us, we'll make it in the end. 

FinalUnrealityCat
U-Secret Studio


------------------------
------------------------

*『Mysteria ~Occult Shadows~』To All Who Support Us! （2019.08.22）

Hey you guys, this is FinalUnrealityCat, the developer of Mysteria~Occult Shadows~, you can call me Cat. 

Finally, the game that contains all of our dream and hope is released today. 
I’d like to say thank you on behalf of the whole team to all who supported us. It is you who made our dream came true. 

We appreciate it very much!!! 

About Early Access version, the total estimated playtime is around 2 hours. It has 4 difficulties and 3 kind of dresses which you can obtain by exploring. In this version, the game have full Japanese voice acting, fully animated CGs, 3 kinda of weapons. 

We plan to complete the game in the future months. We view purchasing EA version of this game as a huge support, so we’ll reward all those who purchase the game during EA with DLCs and exclusive promotions. Also, we know our product is far, far from perfect, so we’ll need all the help we can get. If you have any suggestion or feedback, please don’t hesitate to contact us. You may not be content with the game now, me neither, but we’ll definitely bring you a game you are proud to own. 

The following is something personal I want to say. 

For so long I have this dream of making a game of my own, finally this is the day. It was only a tiny tiny seed when I was a child, but it has blossom into a flower, and it’s majestic. I know these all sound stupid and childish, but they are true from my own heart. 

I love games since I was very little. While other girls were playing with their doll houses and dressing up their Barbies, I was playing computer games, slaying monsters and bringing justice to the world (LOL I know right). To me at that time, game developers were beings that is closest to God him/herself. How could they build such an exquisite world that is as much alive as I am from basically nothing? That was the question I often asked myself. In a way, I wanted to be one of them since then. 

In 2011, I was a pretty active user of Tieba, which was basically a forum. I tried to learn from everything and everyone I could, drawing on tablet, building models, animation, literally everything. An random occasion, I ran into this game engine called Unreal Engine 4. I didn’t know if it was easy to learn or if it’s popular, I just dived in and learned everything I can, till this day. At around the end of 2014, I made 2 demos, and released them for free on the Internet. Although there were media covering these demos, and I gained a little bit of fame. I was plain broke because those demos didn’t get me any income. 

Fortunately, I got some experience from the whole thing. 

At around mid 2015, I started to plan for “Forest Secret”, which was basically a predecessor of Mysteria, I wanted it to be all kemomimi girls (hey, there IS a girls side in me). 

At Sep 2016, I went to university majoring in Digital Media. Since then I’ve been dedicating all my free time (and some of the bed time) to develop the game I wanted. 

But guys, it’s difficult AF. I was young and full of hubris. I thought I learned everything I needed but in fact, I was like a surfer on the sea facing the tsunami. To be honest, there were time I wanted to just give up. But I pulled through, it made me a better person and showed me a whole other world, the world I need learn more about. 

It was not easy, believe me, to balance among game developing, college and pressure from my family. But I met 吉祥 from Jiangnan University. 吉祥 helped me with everything, scripts and all. I’d like to thank 吉祥 for the belief, trust and sacrifice. Thank you! 

Later on that year, it had finally come to this: I spent all the money I have on developing, purchasing resources and outsourcing some of the work, the project was about to halt. I went on Modian (basically a Chinese Kickstarter) for help. I was a huge success, and with that funding, I was able to meet so many people who would like to offer help. So later, we established U-Secret Studio, my very own company, and everything started to fall into its place. 
But you all know how 3D ACT game development can be, it was bitter sweet. We laughed, we cried, we argued, I even smashed a few cups at the wall because of frustration. 

We went on Kickstarter a few months ago with the intention to introduce the game, and people from all over the world surprised my with a 300% of goal from 1109 backer. That was the time of my life, to be acknowledged. 
As I said, this game is far from perfect, and we intend to perfect it in the future. 

For you guys, we’ll definitely present a game that everyone’s content with. 

For belief, we’ll fight till the end! 

Thank you for playing my game.
